title: UI风格#102 - Aztec Revival (阿兹特克复兴)
description: 创建第102种UI风格：阿兹特克复兴风格 - 太阳石、羽毛装饰、金字塔神秘。输出到 G:/claude_code_project/web/index_planCX.html

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aztec Revival style When color palette Then features obsidian black, turquoise, gold, jade green, terracotta
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 需要设计：#0D0D0D (黑曜石), #40E0D0 (绿松石), #FFD700 (阿兹特克金), #00A86B (玉绿), #E07B39 (赤陶)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aztec Revival style When typography Then uses bold aztec: Cinzel, Monteserrat, or Syne
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 字体选择：Cinzel (标题), Montserrat (正文), Syne (替代)

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aztec Revival style When layout Then sun stone motifs, feathered patterns, pyramid steps, geometric grids
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 布局特点：太阳石图案、羽饰、金字塔台阶、几何网格

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aztec Revival style When UI elements Then turquoise inlay, gold accents, feathered borders, stone textures
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 交互特点：绿松石镶嵌、黄金装饰、羽饰边框、石材质感

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aztec Revival UI When functional Then includes temple chat, warrior agents, tribute stats
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 功能需求：神庙聊天、战士代理、贡品统计

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Given Aztec Revival UI When copy Then uses aztec language: 'Temple', 'Sun', 'Feather', 'Jaguar'
acceptance_criteria.evidence: 创意文案：标题'TEMPLE. SUN. FEATHER.'、按钮'SEND'→'OFFER'、'SUBMIT'→'SACRIFICE'
